additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We have observed that the charger last communicated on 28th Dec.
DC Outlets are equipped with LEM, and LEM may have gone out of sync, resulting the outlets set to out of order.
While, As confirmed. AC charging is working.
We can confirm on Out of order due to LEM after we have logs of that particular timeframe.
Charger is on v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164 and we recommend to have charger on latest FW v6.0.3.
Team,
We have observed charge is offline on SCB & OCPP, We need plan site intervention.
We suggest having spare router while site intervention.
